!> Get information about density dependent quantities used in the energy
pure function variable_info(self) result(info)
   use tblite_scf_info, only : scf_info, atom_resolved
   !> Instance of the electrostatic container
   class(damped_multipole), intent(in) :: self
   !> Information on the required potential data
   type(scf_info) :: info

   info = scf_info(dipole=atom_resolved, quadrupole=atom_resolved)
end function variable_info


!> Inspect container cache and reallocate it in case of type mismatch
subroutine taint(cache, ptr)
   !> Instance of the container cache
   type(container_cache), target, intent(inout) :: cache
   !> Reference to the container cache
   type(coulomb_cache), pointer, intent(out) :: ptr

   if (allocated(cache%raw)) then
      call view(cache, ptr)
      if (associated(ptr)) return
      deallocate(cache%raw)
   end if

   if (.not.allocated(cache%raw)) then
      block
         type(coulomb_cache), allocatable :: tmp
         allocate(tmp)
         call move_alloc(tmp, cache%raw)
      end block
   end if

   call view(cache, ptr)
end subroutine taint

!> Return reference to container cache after resolving its type
subroutine view(cache, ptr)
   !> Instance of the container cache
   type(container_cache), target, intent(inout) :: cache
   !> Reference to the container cache
   type(coulomb_cache), pointer, intent(out) :: ptr
   nullify(ptr)
   select type(target => cache%raw)
   type is(coulomb_cache)
      ptr => target
   end select
end subroutine view

subroutine get_energy_axc(self, mol, wfn, energies)
   !> Instance of the multipole container
   class(damped_multipole), intent(in) :: self
   !> Molecular structure data
   type(structure_type), intent(in) :: mol
   !> Wavefunction data
   type(wavefunction_type), intent(in) :: wfn
   !> Electrostatic energy
   real(wp), intent(inout) :: energies(:)

   call get_kernel_energy(mol, self%dkernel, wfn%dpat(:, :, 1), energies)
   call get_kernel_energy(mol, self%qkernel, wfn%qpat(:, :, 1), energies)

end subroutine get_energy_axc

end module tblite_coulomb_multipole

937	   real(wp) :: qpiqj, qiqpj, dpiv, dpjv, tiv(3), tjv(3)
938	
939	   dg(:) = 0.0_wp
940	   ds(:, :) = 0.0_wp
941	   fac = 4*pi/vol
942	   alp2 = alp*alp
943	
944	   do itr = 1, size(trans, 2)
945	      vec(:) = trans(:, itr)
946	      g2 = dot_product(vec, vec)
947	      if (g2 < eps) cycle
948	      gv = dot_product(rij, vec)
949	      expk = fac*exp(-0.25_wp*g2/alp2)/g2
950	      cosk = cos(gv)*expk
951	      sink = sin(gv)*expk
952	
953	      dpiqj = dot_product(vec, mi)*qj
954	      qidpj = dot_product(vec, mj)*qi
955	
956	      dg(:) = dg - 2*vec*cosk * (dpiqj - qidpj)
957	      do b = 1, 3
958	         do a = 1, 3
959	            ds(a, b) = ds(a, b) &
960	               & + 2 * sink * (dpiqj - qidpj) * ((2.0_wp/g2 + 0.5_wp/alp2) * vec(a)*vec(b) - unity(a, b)) &
961	               & - sink*(vec(a)*(qj*mi(b) - qi*mj(b)) + vec(b)*(qj*mi(a) - qi*mj(a)))
962	         end do
963	      end do
964	
965	      dpiv = dot_product(mi, vec)
966	      dpjv = dot_product(mj, vec)
967	
968	      dg(:) = dg + vec*sink*dpiv*dpjv
969	      do b = 1, 3
970	         do a = 1, 3
971	            ds(a, b) = ds(a, b) &
972	               & + cosk * dpiv*dpjv * ((2.0_wp/g2 + 0.5_wp/alp2) * vec(a)*vec(b) - unity(a, b)) &
973	               & - 0.5_wp*cosk*(vec(a)*(mi(b)*dpjv + mj(b)*dpiv) + vec(b)*(mi(a)*dpjv + mj(a)*dpiv))
974	         end do
975	      end do
976	
977	      qiqpj = qi*(tj(1)*vec(1)*vec(1) + tj(3)*vec(2)*vec(2) + tj(6)*vec(3)*vec(3) &
978	         & + 2*tj(2)*vec(1)*vec(2) + 2*tj(4)*vec(1)*vec(3) + 2*tj(5)*vec(2)*vec(3))
979	      qpiqj = qj*(ti(1)*vec(1)*vec(1) + ti(3)*vec(2)*vec(2) + ti(6)*vec(3)*vec(3) &
980	         & + 2*ti(2)*vec(1)*vec(2) + 2*ti(4)*vec(1)*vec(3) + 2*ti(5)*vec(2)*vec(3))

982	         & ti(2)*vec(1) + ti(3)*vec(2) + ti(5)*vec(3), &
983	         & ti(4)*vec(1) + ti(5)*vec(2) + ti(6)*vec(3)]
984	      tjv = [tj(1)*vec(1) + tj(2)*vec(2) + tj(4)*vec(3), &
985	         & tj(2)*vec(1) + tj(3)*vec(2) + tj(5)*vec(3), &
986	         & tj(4)*vec(1) + tj(5)*vec(2) + tj(6)*vec(3)]
987	
988	      dg(:) = dg + vec * sink * (qiqpj + qpiqj)
989	      do b = 1, 3
990	         do a = 1, 3
991	            ds(a, b) = ds(a, b) &
992	               & + cosk * (qiqpj + qpiqj) * ((2.0_wp/g2 + 0.5_wp/alp2) * vec(a)*vec(b) - unity(a, b)) &
993	               & - cosk*(vec(a)*(qi*tjv(b) + qj*tiv(b)) + vec(b)*(qi*tjv(a) + qj*tiv(a)))

875	   !$omp shared(mol, wsc, kdmp3, kdmp5, vol, alpha, rtrans, dtrans, rad, qat, dpat, qpat) &
876	   !$omp private(iat, jat, dE, dG, dS, wsw, img, vec, rr, dEd, dGd, dGr, dSd, dSr)

881	         dS(:, :) = 0.0_wp

883	         do img = 1, wsc%nimg(jat, iat)
884	            vec(:) = mol%xyz(:, jat)-mol%xyz(:, iat) + wsc%trans(:, wsc%tridx(img, jat, iat))

891	            dE = dE + dEd * wsw

904	   !$omp shared(mol, wsc, kdmp3, kdmp5, vol, alpha, rtrans, dtrans, rad, qat, dpat, qpat) &
905	   !$omp private(iat, jat, dE, dG, dS, wsw, img, vec, rr, dEd, dGd, dGr, dSd, dSr)
906	   do iat = 1, mol%nat
907	      dE = 0.0_wp
908	      dS(:, :) = 0.0_wp
909	      wsw = 1.0_wp / real(wsc%nimg(iat, iat), wp)
910	      do img = 1, wsc%nimg(iat, iat)
911	         vec(:) = wsc%trans(:, wsc%tridx(img, iat, iat))
912	         rr = rad(iat)

914	         call get_damat_sdq_rec_3d(vec, qat(iat), qat(iat), dpat(:, iat), dpat(:, iat), &

import numpy as np
from math import erf, exp, sqrt, pi, sin, cos
SQRTPI = sqrt(pi)
EPS = 1e-12  # tblite uses epsilon-ish threshold

def latpoints(mat, cutoff):
    # mat columns are lattice vectors: T = mat @ n
    inv = np.linalg.inv(mat)
    # bounding box
    n = []
    lim = []
    for k in range(3):
        # max |n_k| : use reciprocal norm
        lim.append(int(np.ceil(cutoff*np.linalg.norm(inv[k, :]))) + 1)
    pts = []
    for i in range(-lim[0], lim[0]+1):
        for j in range(-lim[1], lim[1]+1):
            for k in range(-lim[2], lim[2]+1):
                v = mat @ np.array([i, j, k], dtype=float)
                if np.linalg.norm(v) <= cutoff:
                    pts.append(v)
    return np.array(pts)

class Kern:
    """Parameterised port of tblite's periodic AES kernels."""
    def __init__(self, c_sd=2.0, c_dd=1.0, c_sq=1.0, k_dd=1.0/6.0, k_sq=-1.0/9.0,
                 g_sd=2.0, g_dd=1.0, g_sq=1.0):
        # energy coefficients
        self.c_sd, self.c_dd, self.c_sq = c_sd, c_dd, c_sq
        self.k_dd, self.k_sq = k_dd, k_sq        # constants as multiples of fac
        # gradient coefficients
        self.g_sd, self.g_dd, self.g_sq = g_sd, g_dd, g_sq

    # ---------------- energy matrices ----------------
    def amat_rec(self, rij, vol, alp, rtrans):
        fac = 4*pi/vol
        sd = np.zeros(3); dd = np.zeros((3, 3)); sq = np.zeros(6)
        dd += np.eye(3)*fac*self.k_dd
        sq[[0, 2, 5]] += fac*self.k_sq
        for g in rtrans:
            g2 = g @ g
            if g2 < EPS: continue
            gv = rij @ g
            expk = fac*exp(-0.25*g2/(alp*alp))/g2
            sink = sin(gv)*expk; cosk = cos(gv)*expk
            sd += self.c_sd*g*sink
            dd += self.c_dd*np.outer(g, g)*cosk
            c = self.c_sq*cosk
            sq[0] += c*g[0]*g[0]; sq[1] += 2*c*g[0]*g[1]; sq[2] += c*g[1]*g[1]
            sq[3] += 2*c*g[0]*g[2]; sq[4] += 2*c*g[1]*g[2]; sq[5] += c*g[2]*g[2]
        return sd, dd, sq

    def amat_dir(self, rij, rr, kdmp3, kdmp5, alp, dtrans):
        sd = np.zeros(3); dd = np.zeros((3, 3)); sq = np.zeros(6)
        alp2 = alp*alp
        for t in dtrans:
            vec = rij + t
            r1 = np.linalg.norm(vec)
            if r1 < 1e-10: continue
            g1 = 1.0/r1; g3 = g1**3; g5 = g3*g1*g1
            fdmp3 = 1.0/(1.0 + 6.0*(rr/r1)**kdmp3)
            fdmp5 = 1.0/(1.0 + 6.0*(rr/r1)**kdmp5)
            arg = r1*alp; expt = exp(-arg*arg)/SQRTPI; erft = -erf(arg)*g1
            e1 = g1*g1*(erft + 2*expt*alp)
            e2 = g1*g1*(e1 + 4*expt*alp2*alp/3)
            sd += vec*(fdmp3*g3 + e1)
            dd += np.eye(3)*(fdmp5*g3 + e1) - np.outer(vec, vec)*3*(g5*fdmp5 + e2)
            b = g5*fdmp5 + e2; a = (fdmp5*g3 + e1)/3.0
            sq[0] += vec[0]*vec[0]*b - a
            sq[1] += 2*vec[0]*vec[1]*b
            sq[2] += vec[1]*vec[1]*b - a
            sq[3] += 2*vec[0]*vec[2]*b
            sq[4] += 2*vec[1]*vec[2]*b
            sq[5] += vec[2]*vec[2]*b - a
        return sd, dd, sq

    def matrices(self, xyz, lattice, rad, kdmp3, kdmp5, alp, dtrans, rtrans):
        nat = len(xyz)
        vol = abs(np.linalg.det(lattice))
        A_sd = np.zeros((3, nat, nat)); A_dd = np.zeros((3, nat, 3, nat)); A_sq = np.zeros((6, nat, nat))
        for iat in range(nat):
            for jat in range(nat):
                vec = xyz[iat] - xyz[jat]
                rr = 0.5*(rad[jat] + rad[iat])
                rsd, rdd, rsq = self.amat_rec(vec, vol, alp, rtrans)
                dsd, ddd, dsq = self.amat_dir(vec, rr, kdmp3, kdmp5, alp, dtrans)
                A_sd[:, jat, iat] += rsd + dsd
                A_dd[:, jat, :, iat] += rdd + ddd
                A_sq[:, jat, iat] += rsq + dsq
        for iat in range(nat):
            rr = -2.0/3.0*alp**3/SQRTPI
            for k in range(3):
                A_dd[k, iat, k, iat] += 2*rr
            rr = 4.0/9.0*alp**3/SQRTPI
            A_sq[[0, 2, 5], iat, iat] += rr
        return A_sd, A_dd, A_sq

    def energy(self, xyz, lattice, rad, kdmp3, kdmp5, alp, q, dp, qp, dtrans, rtrans):
        nat = len(xyz)
        A_sd, A_dd, A_sq = self.matrices(xyz, lattice, rad, kdmp3, kdmp5, alp, dtrans, rtrans)
        e = 0.0
        for i in range(nat):
            for j in range(nat):
                e += q[i]*(dp[j] @ A_sd[:, j, i])
                e += 0.5*(dp[j] @ A_dd[:, j, :, i] @ dp[i])
                e += q[i]*(qp[j] @ A_sq[:, j, i])
        return e

    # ---------------- gradient ----------------
    def damat_rec(self, rij, qi, qj, mi, mj, ti, tj, vol, alp, rtrans):
        fac = 4*pi/vol; alp2 = alp*alp
        dg = np.zeros(3); ds = np.zeros((3, 3))
        for g in rtrans:
            g2 = g @ g
            if g2 < EPS: continue
            gv = rij @ g
            expk = fac*exp(-0.25*g2/alp2)/g2
            cosk = cos(gv)*expk; sink = sin(gv)*expk
            dpiqj = (g @ mi)*qj; qidpj = (g @ mj)*qi
            dg += -self.g_sd*g*cosk*(dpiqj - qidpj)
            pref = (2.0/g2 + 0.5/alp2)
            ds += self.g_sd*sink*(dpiqj - qidpj)*(pref*np.outer(g, g) - np.eye(3)) \
                - 0.5*self.g_sd*sink*(np.outer(g, qj*mi - qi*mj) + np.outer(qj*mi - qi*mj, g))
            dpiv = mi @ g; dpjv = mj @ g
            dg += self.g_dd*g*sink*dpiv*dpjv
            ds += self.g_dd*(cosk*dpiv*dpjv*(pref*np.outer(g, g) - np.eye(3))
                             - 0.5*cosk*(np.outer(g, mi*dpjv + mj*dpiv) + np.outer(mi*dpjv + mj*dpiv, g)))
            T = lambda t: np.array([[t[0], t[1], t[3]], [t[1], t[2], t[4]], [t[3], t[4], t[5]]])
            Ti = T(ti); Tj = T(tj)
            qiqpj = qi*(g @ Tj @ g); qpiqj = qj*(g @ Ti @ g)
            tiv = Ti @ g; tjv = Tj @ g
            dg += self.g_sq*g*sink*(qiqpj + qpiqj)
            ds += self.g_sq*(cosk*(qiqpj + qpiqj)*(pref*np.outer(g, g) - np.eye(3))
                             - cosk*(np.outer(g, qi*tjv + qj*tiv) + np.outer(qi*tjv + qj*tiv, g)))
        return dg, ds

    def damat_dir(self, rij, qi, qj, mi, mj, ti, tj, rr, kdmp3, kdmp5, alp, dtrans):
        alp2 = alp*alp
        de = 0.0; dg = np.zeros(3); ds = np.zeros((3, 3))
        T = lambda t: np.array([[t[0], t[1], t[3]], [t[1], t[2], t[4]], [t[3], t[4], t[5]]])
        Ti = T(ti); Tj = T(tj)
        for t in dtrans:
            vec = rij + t
            r1 = np.linalg.norm(vec)
            if r1 < 1e-10: continue
            r2 = r1*r1; g1 = 1.0/r1; g3 = g1**3; g5 = g3*g1*g1; g7 = g5*g1*g1
            arg = r1*alp; erft = -erf(arg)*g1; expt = exp(-arg*arg)/SQRTPI
            e1 = g1*g1*(erft + expt*(2*alp2)/alp)
            e2 = g1*g1*(e1 + expt*(2*alp2)**2/(3*alp))
            e3 = g1*g1*(e2 + expt*(2*alp2)**3/(15*alp))
            fdmp3 = 1.0/(1.0 + 6.0*(rr*g1)**kdmp3)
            ddmp3 = -3*fdmp3 - kdmp3*fdmp3*(fdmp3 - 1.0)
            fdmp5 = 1.0/(1.0 + 6.0*(rr*g1)**kdmp5)
            ddmp5 = -5*fdmp5 - kdmp5*(fdmp5*fdmp5 - fdmp5)
            dpiqj = (vec @ mi)*qj; qidpj = (vec @ mj)*qi
            dpidpj = mi @ mj; dpiv = mi @ vec; dpjv = mj @ vec
            edd = dpidpj*r2 - 3*dpjv*dpiv
            g_sd = -(ddmp3*g5)*vec*(dpiqj - qidpj) + fdmp3*g3*(qi*mj - qj*mi)
            tab = 3*np.outer(vec, vec)*e2 - np.eye(3)*e1
            g_sd = g_sd + qj*(tab.T @ mi) - qi*(tab.T @ mj)
            de += 3.0*(dpiqj - qidpj)*kdmp3*fdmp3*g3*(fdmp3/rr)*(rr*g1)**kdmp3
            dg += g_sd
            ds += -0.5*(np.outer(vec, g_sd) + np.outer(g_sd, vec))
            g_dd = -2.0*fdmp5*g5*dpidpj*vec + 3.0*fdmp5*g5*(dpiv*mj + dpjv*mi) - edd*ddmp5*g7*vec
            tabc = -15*np.einsum('a,b,c->abc', vec, vec, vec)*e3
            for c in range(3):
                for a in range(3):
                    tabc[a, a, c] += 3*e2*vec[c]
                    tabc[c, a, c] += 3*e2*vec[a]
                    tabc[a, c, c] += 3*e2*vec[a]
            g_dd = g_dd + np.einsum('a,abk,b->k', mi, tabc, mj)
            de += 3.0*edd*kdmp5*fdmp5*g5*(fdmp5/rr)*(rr*g1)**kdmp5
            dg += g_dd
            ds += -0.5*(np.outer(vec, g_dd) + np.outer(g_dd, vec))
            M = qj*Ti + qi*Tj
            eq = vec @ M @ vec
            g_sq = -eq*ddmp5*g7*vec - 2.0*fdmp5*g5*qi*(Tj @ vec) - 2.0*fdmp5*g5*qj*(Ti @ vec)
            g_sq = g_sq + (-qi*np.einsum('abk,ab->k', tabc, Tj) - qj*np.einsum('abk,ab->k', tabc, Ti))/3.0
            de += eq*3.0*kdmp5*fdmp5*g5*fdmp5/rr*(rr*g1)**kdmp5
            dg += g_sq
            ds += -0.5*(np.outer(vec, g_sq) + np.outer(g_sq, vec))
        return de, dg, ds

    def gradient(self, xyz, lattice, rad, kdmp3, kdmp5, alp, q, dp, qp, dtrans, rtrans):
        nat = len(xyz)
        vol = abs(np.linalg.det(lattice))
        grad = np.zeros((nat, 3)); sigma = np.zeros((3, 3)); dEdr = np.zeros(nat)
        for iat in range(nat):
            for jat in range(iat):
                vec = xyz[jat] - xyz[iat]
                rr = 0.5*(rad[jat] + rad[iat])
                dgr, dsr = self.damat_rec(vec, q[iat], q[jat], dp[iat], dp[jat], qp[iat], qp[jat], vol, alp, rtrans)
                ded, dgd, dsd = self.damat_dir(vec, q[iat], q[jat], dp[iat], dp[jat], qp[iat], qp[jat], rr, kdmp3, kdmp5, alp, dtrans)
                grad[iat] += dgd + dgr
                grad[jat] -= dgd + dgr
                sigma += dsd + dsr
                dEdr[iat] += ded; dEdr[jat] += ded
        for iat in range(nat):
            vec = np.zeros(3)
            rr = rad[iat]
            dgr, dsr = self.damat_rec(vec, q[iat], q[iat], dp[iat], dp[iat], qp[iat], qp[iat], vol, alp, rtrans)
            ded, dgd, dsd = self.damat_dir(vec, q[iat], q[iat], dp[iat], dp[iat], qp[iat], qp[iat], rr, kdmp3, kdmp5, alp, dtrans)
            sigma += 0.5*(dsd + dsr)
            dEdr[iat] += ded
        return grad, sigma, dEdr

rtrans = latpoints(2*pi*np.linalg.inv(lattice).T, 6.0)

def phi(r):
    """periodic Coulomb potential kernel (tinfoil Ewald), regularised at r=0"""
    s = 0.0
    for t in dtrans:
        v = r + t; rn = np.linalg.norm(v)
        if rn < 1e-12: continue
        s += erfc(alp*rn)/rn
    for g in rtrans:
        g2 = g @ g
        if g2 < 1e-12: continue
        s += 4*pi/vol*exp(-0.25*g2/alp**2)*cos(g @ r)/g2
    return s

PHI_SELF = -2*alp/SQ + sum(4*pi/vol*exp(-0.25*(g@g)/alp**2)/(g@g) for g in rtrans if g@g > 1e-12)

def ewald_charges(pos, chg):
    e = 0.0
    n = len(pos)
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            if i == j:
                e += 0.5*chg[i]**2*PHI_SELF
            else:
                e += 0.5*chg[i]*chg[j]*phi(pos[i]-pos[j])
    return e

# ---- sites: 2 sites, dipoles + charges + quadrupole ----
R = np.array([[0.5, 0.3, -0.2], [3.7, 1.4, 2.2]])
mu = np.array([[0.4, -0.2, 0.3], [-0.1, 0.5, 0.2]])

    k = Kern(**kw)
    return k.energy(R, lattice, rad, kdmp3, kdmp5, alp, q, dp, qp, dtrans, rtrans)

    intra = 0.0
    for A in range(2):
        d = mu[A]/qmag
        pos += [R[A]+d/2, R[A]-d/2]; chg += [qmag, -qmag]
        intra += -qmag**2/np.linalg.norm(d)

pure subroutine shift_operator(vec, s, di, qi, ds, ddi, dqi, ddj, dqj)
   real(wp),intent(in) :: vec(:)
   real(wp),intent(in) :: s
   real(wp),intent(in) :: di(:)
   real(wp),intent(in) :: qi(:)
   real(wp),intent(in) :: ds(:)
   real(wp),intent(in) :: ddi(:, :)
   real(wp),intent(in) :: dqi(:, :)
   real(wp),intent(out) :: ddj(:, :)
   real(wp),intent(out) :: dqj(:, :)

   ddj(:, 1) = ddi(:, 1) - vec(1)*ds
   ddj(:, 2) = ddi(:, 2) - vec(2)*ds
   ddj(:, 3) = ddi(:, 3) - vec(3)*ds
   ddj(1, 1) = ddj(1, 1) - s
   ddj(2, 2) = ddj(2, 2) - s
   ddj(3, 3) = ddj(3, 3) - s

   dqj(:, 1) = dqi(:, 1) - 2*vec(1)*ddi(:, 1) + vec(1)**2*ds
   dqj(:, 3) = dqi(:, 3) - 2*vec(2)*ddi(:, 2) + vec(2)**2*ds
   dqj(:, 6) = dqi(:, 6) - 2*vec(3)*ddi(:, 3) + vec(3)**2*ds

   amat_sd = 0.0_wp

   amat_sq = 0.0_wp
   fac = 4*pi/vol

   ! The multipole interaction kernels are derivatives of the same lattice sum of
   ! the Coulomb potential used for the isotropic (charge-charge) interactions
   !
   !    φ(r) = Σ(T) erfc(α|r+T|)/|r+T| + 4π/V Σ(G≠0) exp(-G²/4α²) cos(G·r)/G²
   !
   ! evaluated for a compensating background (tinfoil boundary conditions), i.e.
   !
   !    A_sd(r) = -∇φ(r),  A_dd(r) = -∇∇φ(r),  A_sq(r) = ∇∇φ(r)/3 = -A_dd(r)/3
   !
   ! Since the omitted G=0 contribution to φ is independent of r, its derivatives
   ! vanish and no constant terms are added here. Keeping the kernels exact
   ! derivatives of φ is what makes the Ewald splitting parameter α drop out of
   ! the total energy and therefore ensures that equivalent representations of the
   ! same periodic system (super cells, cell choices) yield identical energies.
   do itr = 1, size(trans, 2)
      vec(:) = trans(:, itr)
      g2 = dot_product(vec, vec)
      if (g2 < eps) cycle
      gv = dot_product(rij, vec)
      expk = fac*exp(-0.25_wp*g2/(alp*alp))/g2
      sink = sin(gv)*expk
      cosk = cos(gv)*expk

      amat_sd(:) = amat_sd + vec*sink
      amat_dd(:, :) = amat_dd + spread(vec, 1, 3) * spread(vec, 2, 3) * cosk
      amat_sq(1) = amat_sq(1) - (  vec(1)*vec(1)*cosk)/3.0_wp
      amat_sq(2) = amat_sq(2) - (2*vec(1)*vec(2)*cosk)/3.0_wp

      amat_sq(6) = amat_sq(6) - (  vec(3)*vec(3)*cosk)/3.0_wp

   xr = x

pure function dir_value(self, dist, alpha, vol) result(val)

subroutine get_amat_dir_3d(rij, gam, gexp, rcut, alp, trans, amat)
   !> Distance between pair
   real(wp), intent(in) :: rij(3)
   !> Hubbard parameter
   real(wp), intent(in) :: gam

   real(wp), intent(in) :: rcut
   !> Convergence factor
   real(wp), intent(in) :: alp
   !> Translation vectors to consider
   real(wp), intent(in) :: trans(:, :)
   !> Interaction matrix element
   real(wp), intent(out) :: amat

   integer :: itr
   real(wp) :: vec(3), r1, tmp, fcut

   amat = 0.0_wp

   do itr = 1, size(trans, 2)
      vec(:) = rij + trans(:, itr)
      r1 = norm2(vec)
      if (r1 < eps) cycle
      fcut = fsmooth(r1, rcut)

subroutine get_rec_trans(lattice, alpha, volume, conv, trans)
   !> Lattice parameters
   real(wp), intent(in) :: lattice(:, :)
   !> Parameter for Ewald summation
   real(wp), intent(in) :: alpha
   !> Cell volume
   real(wp), intent(in) :: volume
   !> Tolerance for Ewald summation
   real(wp), intent(in) :: conv
   !> Translation vectors

   real(wp) :: rec_lat(3, 3)

   rec_lat = twopi*transpose(matinv_3x3(lattice))

   !> Instance of the multipole container
   class(damped_multipole), intent(in) :: self

   type(structure_type), intent(in) :: mol
   !> Reusable data container
   type(coulomb_cache), intent(inout) :: cache

   real(wp), intent(inout) :: amat_sd(:, :, :)
   !> Interation matrix for dipoles and dipoles
   real(wp), intent(inout) :: amat_dd(:, :, :, :)
   !> Interation matrix for charges and quadrupoles

         & cache%wsc, cache%alpha, amat_sd, amat_dd, amat_sq)

!> Calculate the multipole interaction matrix for finite systems
subroutine get_multipole_matrix_0d(mol, rad, kdmp3, kdmp5, amat_sd, amat_dd, amat_sq)
   !> Molecular structure data
   type(structure_type), intent(in) :: mol
   !> Multipole damping radii for all atoms
   real(wp), intent(in) :: rad(:)
   !> Damping function for inverse quadratic contributions
   real(wp), intent(in) :: kdmp3
   !> Damping function for inverse cubic contributions
   real(wp), intent(in) :: kdmp5
   !> Interaction matrix for charges and dipoles
   real(wp), intent(inout) :: amat_sd(:, :, :)
   !> Interaction matrix for dipoles and dipoles
   real(wp), intent(inout) :: amat_dd(:, :, :, :)
   !> Interaction matrix for charges and quadrupoles
   real(wp), intent(inout) :: amat_sq(:, :, :)

   integer :: iat, jat
   real(wp) :: r1, vec(3), g1, g3, g5, fdmp3, fdmp5, tc(6), rr

   !$omp parallel do default(none) schedule(runtime) collapse(2) &
   !$omp shared(amat_sd, amat_dd, amat_sq, mol, rad, kdmp3, kdmp5) &
   !$omp private(r1, vec, g1, g3, g5, fdmp3, fdmp5, tc, rr)
   do iat = 1, mol%nat
      do jat = 1, mol%nat
         if (iat == jat) cycle
         vec(:) = mol%xyz(:, iat) - mol%xyz(:, jat)
         r1 = norm2(vec)
         g1 = 1.0_wp / r1
         g3 = g1 * g1 * g1
         g5 = g3 * g1 * g1

         rr = 0.5_wp * (rad(jat) + rad(iat)) * g1
         fdmp3 = 1.0_wp / (1.0_wp + 6.0_wp * rr**kdmp3)
         fdmp5 = 1.0_wp / (1.0_wp + 6.0_wp * rr**kdmp5)

         amat_sd(:, jat, iat) = amat_sd(:, jat, iat) + vec * g3 * fdmp3
         amat_dd(:, jat, :, iat) = amat_dd(:, jat, :, iat) &
            & + unity * g3*fdmp5 - spread(vec, 1, 3) * spread(vec, 2, 3) * 3*g5*fdmp5
         tc(2) = 2*vec(1)*vec(2)*g5*fdmp5
         tc(4) = 2*vec(1)*vec(3)*g5*fdmp5
         tc(5) = 2*vec(2)*vec(3)*g5*fdmp5
         tc(1) = vec(1)*vec(1)*g5*fdmp5
         tc(3) = vec(2)*vec(2)*g5*fdmp5
         tc(6) = vec(3)*vec(3)*g5*fdmp5
         amat_sq(:, jat, iat) = amat_sq(:, jat, iat) + tc
      end do
   end do
end subroutine get_multipole_matrix_0d

!> Evaluate multipole interaction matrix under 3D periodic boundary conditions
subroutine get_multipole_matrix_3d(mol, rad, kdmp3, kdmp5, wsc, alpha, &
      & amat_sd, amat_dd, amat_sq)
   !> Molecular structure data
   type(structure_type), intent(in) :: mol
   !> Multipole damping radii for all atoms
   real(wp), intent(in) :: rad(:)
   !> Damping function for inverse quadratic contributions
   real(wp), intent(in) :: kdmp3
   !> Damping function for inverse cubic contributions
   real(wp), intent(in) :: kdmp5
   !> Wigner-Seitz cell images
   type(wignerseitz_cell), intent(in) :: wsc
   !> Convergence parameter for Ewald sum
   real(wp), intent(in) :: alpha
   !> Interation matrix for charges and dipoles
   real(wp), intent(inout) :: amat_sd(:, :, :)
   !> Interation matrix for dipoles and dipoles
   real(wp), intent(inout) :: amat_dd(:, :, :, :)
   !> Interation matrix for charges and quadrupoles
   real(wp), intent(inout) :: amat_sq(:, :, :)

   integer :: iat, jat, img, k
   real(wp) :: vec(3), rr, wsw, vol
   real(wp) :: d_sd(3), d_dd(3, 3), d_sq(6), r_sd(3), r_dd(3, 3), r_sq(6)
   real(wp), allocatable :: dtrans(:, :), rtrans(:, :)

   vol = abs(matdet_3x3(mol%lattice))
   call get_dir_trans(mol%lattice, alpha, conv, dtrans)
   call get_rec_trans(mol%lattice, alpha, vol, conv, rtrans)

   !$omp parallel do default(none) schedule(runtime) collapse(2) &
   !$omp shared(amat_sd, amat_dd, amat_sq) &
   !$omp shared(mol, wsc, rad, vol, alpha, rtrans, dtrans, kdmp3, kdmp5) &
   !$omp private(iat, jat, img, vec, rr, wsw, d_sd, d_dd, d_sq, r_sd, r_dd, r_sq)
   do iat = 1, mol%nat
      do jat = 1, mol%nat
         wsw = 1.0_wp / real(wsc%nimg(jat, iat), wp)
         do img = 1, wsc%nimg(jat, iat)
            vec = mol%xyz(:, iat) - mol%xyz(:, jat) - wsc%trans(:, wsc%tridx(img, jat, iat))

            rr = 0.5_wp * (rad(jat) + rad(iat))
            call get_amat_sdq_rec_3d(vec, vol, alpha, rtrans, r_sd, r_dd, r_sq)
            call get_amat_sdq_dir_3d(vec, rr, kdmp3, kdmp5, alpha, dtrans, d_sd, d_dd, d_sq)

            amat_sd(:, jat, iat) = amat_sd(:, jat, iat) + wsw * (d_sd + r_sd)
            amat_dd(:, jat, :, iat) = amat_dd(:, jat, :, iat) + wsw * (r_dd + d_dd)
            amat_sq(:, jat, iat) = amat_sq(:, jat, iat) + wsw * (r_sq + d_sq)
         end do
      end do
   end do

   !$omp parallel do default(none) schedule(runtime) &
   !$omp shared(amat_sd, amat_dd, amat_sq, mol, vol, alpha) private(iat, rr, k)
   do iat = 1, mol%nat
      ! dipole-dipole selfenergy: -2/3·α³/sqrt(π) Σ(i) μ²(i)
      rr = -2.0_wp/3.0_wp * alpha**3 / sqrtpi
      do k = 1, 3
         amat_dd(k, iat, k, iat) = amat_dd(k, iat, k, iat) + 2*rr
      end do

      ! charge-quadrupole selfenergy: 4/9·α³/sqrt(π) Σ(i) q(i)Tr(θi)
      ! (no actual contribution since quadrupoles are traceless)
      rr = 4.0_wp/9.0_wp * alpha**3 / sqrtpi
      amat_sq([1, 3, 6], iat, iat) = amat_sq([1, 3, 6], iat, iat) + rr
   end do
end subroutine get_multipole_matrix_3d

pure subroutine get_amat_sdq_rec_3d(rij, vol, alp, trans, amat_sd, amat_dd, amat_sq)
   real(wp), intent(in) :: rij(3)
   real(wp), intent(in) :: vol
   real(wp), intent(in) :: alp
   real(wp), intent(in) :: trans(:, :)
   real(wp), intent(out) :: amat_sd(:)
   real(wp), intent(out) :: amat_dd(:, :)
   real(wp), intent(out) :: amat_sq(:)

   integer :: itr
   real(wp) :: fac, vec(3), g2, expk, sink, cosk, gv

   amat_sd = 0.0_wp
   amat_dd = 0.0_wp
   amat_sq = 0.0_wp
   fac = 4*pi/vol

   ! The multipole interaction kernels are derivatives of the same lattice sum of
   ! the Coulomb potential used for the isotropic (charge-charge) interactions
   !
   !    φ(r) = Σ(T) erfc(α|r+T|)/|r+T| + 4π/V Σ(G≠0) exp(-G²/4α²) cos(G·r)/G²
   !
   ! evaluated for a compensating background (tinfoil boundary conditions), i.e.
   !
   !    A_sd(r) = -∇φ(r),  A_dd(r) = -∇∇φ(r),  A_sq(r) = ∇∇φ(r)/3 = -A_dd(r)/3
   !
   ! Since the omitted G=0 contribution to φ is independent of r, its derivatives
   ! vanish and no constant terms are added here. Keeping the kernels exact
   ! derivatives of φ is what makes the Ewald splitting parameter α drop out of
   ! the total energy and therefore ensures that equivalent representations of the
   ! same periodic system (super cells, cell choices) yield identical energies.
   do itr = 1, size(trans, 2)
      vec(:) = trans(:, itr)
      g2 = dot_product(vec, vec)
      if (g2 < eps) cycle
      gv = dot_product(rij, vec)
      expk = fac*exp(-0.25_wp*g2/(alp*alp))/g2
      sink = sin(gv)*expk
      cosk = cos(gv)*expk

      amat_sd(:) = amat_sd + vec*sink
      amat_dd(:, :) = amat_dd + spread(vec, 1, 3) * spread(vec, 2, 3) * cosk
      amat_sq(1) = amat_sq(1) - (  vec(1)*vec(1)*cosk)/3.0_wp
      amat_sq(2) = amat_sq(2) - (2*vec(1)*vec(2)*cosk)/3.0_wp
      amat_sq(3) = amat_sq(3) - (  vec(2)*vec(2)*cosk)/3.0_wp
      amat_sq(4) = amat_sq(4) - (2*vec(1)*vec(3)*cosk)/3.0_wp
      amat_sq(5) = amat_sq(5) - (2*vec(2)*vec(3)*cosk)/3.0_wp
      amat_sq(6) = amat_sq(6) - (  vec(3)*vec(3)*cosk)/3.0_wp
   end do

end subroutine get_amat_sdq_rec_3d

pure subroutine get_amat_sdq_dir_3d(rij, rr, kdmp3, kdmp5, alp, trans, &
      & amat_sd, amat_dd, amat_sq)
   real(wp), intent(in) :: rij(3)
   real(wp), intent(in) :: rr
   real(wp), intent(in) :: kdmp3
   real(wp), intent(in) :: kdmp5
   real(wp), intent(in) :: alp
   real(wp), intent(in) :: trans(:, :)
   real(wp), intent(out) :: amat_sd(:)
   real(wp), intent(out) :: amat_dd(:, :)
   real(wp), intent(out) :: amat_sq(:)

   integer :: itr
   real(wp) :: vec(3), r1, tmp, fdmp3, fdmp5, g1, g3, g5, arg, arg2, alp2, e1, e2, erft, expt

   amat_sd = 0.0_wp
   amat_dd = 0.0_wp
   amat_sq = 0.0_wp
   alp2 = alp*alp

   do itr = 1, size(trans, 2)
      vec(:) = rij + trans(:, itr)
      r1 = norm2(vec)
      if (r1 < eps) cycle
      g1 = 1.0_wp/r1
      g3 = g1 * g1 * g1
      g5 = g3 * g1 * g1
      fdmp3 = 1.0_wp / (1.0_wp + 6.0_wp * (rr/r1)**kdmp3)
      fdmp5 = 1.0_wp / (1.0_wp + 6.0_wp * (rr/r1)**kdmp5)

      arg = r1*alp
      arg2 = arg*arg
      expt = exp(-arg2)/sqrtpi
      erft = -erf(arg)*g1
      e1 = g1*g1 * (erft + 2*expt*alp)
      e2 = g1*g1 * (e1 + 4*expt*alp2*alp/3)

      tmp = fdmp3 * g3 + e1
      amat_sd = amat_sd + vec * tmp
      amat_dd(:, :) = amat_dd(:, :) + unity * (fdmp5*g3 + e1) &
         & - spread(vec, 1, 3) * spread(vec, 2, 3) * (3 * (g5*fdmp5 + e2))
      amat_sq(1) = amat_sq(1) +   vec(1)*vec(1)*(g5*fdmp5 + e2) - (fdmp5*g3 + e1)/3.0_wp
      amat_sq(2) = amat_sq(2) + 2*vec(1)*vec(2)*(g5*fdmp5 + e2)
      amat_sq(3) = amat_sq(3) +   vec(2)*vec(2)*(g5*fdmp5 + e2) - (fdmp5*g3 + e1)/3.0_wp
      amat_sq(4) = amat_sq(4) + 2*vec(1)*vec(3)*(g5*fdmp5 + e2)
      amat_sq(5) = amat_sq(5) + 2*vec(2)*vec(3)*(g5*fdmp5 + e2)
      amat_sq(6) = amat_sq(6) +   vec(3)*vec(3)*(g5*fdmp5 + e2) - (fdmp5*g3 + e1)/3.0_wp
   end do

end subroutine get_amat_sdq_dir_3d

def dir_mp_value(R, a): 
    x = a*R
    return (2/SQ*x*exp(-x*x) + erfc(x))/R**3
def rec_mp_value(G, a, V): return 4*pi*exp(-0.25*G*G/a**2)/V
def dir_value(R, a): return erfc(a*R)/R
def rec_value(G, a, V): return 4*pi*exp(-0.25*G*G/a**2)/(V*G*G)

def search_alpha(lat, mp=True):
    V = abs(np.linalg.det(lat)); rec = 2*pi*np.linalg.inv(lat).T
    rlen = min(np.linalg.norm(rec[:, k]) for k in range(3))
    dlen = min(np.linalg.norm(lat[:, k]) for k in range(3))
    dv = dir_mp_value if mp else dir_value
    rv = rec_mp_value if mp else rec_value
    f = lambda a: rv(rlen, a, V) - dv(dlen, a)
    a = 1.49e-8
    while f(a) < -1e-8: a *= 2
    al = 0.5*a
    while f(a) < 1e-8: a *= 2
    ar = a
    for _ in range(40):
        a = 0.5*(al+ar)
        if f(a) < 0: al = a
        else: ar = a
    return a

def search_cutoff(val, a, V, conv):
    x = 1.49e-8
    while val(x, a, V) > conv if V else val(x, a) > conv:
        x *= 2
    xl, xr = 0.5*x, x
    g = (lambda y: val(y, a, V)) if V else (lambda y: val(y, a))
    for _ in range(40):
        x = 0.5*(xl+xr)
        if g(x) >= conv: xl = x
        else: xr = x
    return x

import numpy as np
from math import erf, exp, sqrt, pi, sin, cos
SQRTPI = sqrt(pi)
EPS = 1e-12  # tblite uses epsilon-ish threshold

def latpoints(mat, cutoff):
    # mat columns are lattice vectors: T = mat @ n
    inv = np.linalg.inv(mat)
    # bounding box
    n = []
    lim = []
    for k in range(3):
        # max |n_k| : use reciprocal norm
        lim.append(int(np.ceil(cutoff*np.linalg.norm(inv[k, :]))) + 1)
    pts = []
    for i in range(-lim[0], lim[0]+1):
        for j in range(-lim[1], lim[1]+1):
            for k in range(-lim[2], lim[2]+1):
                v = mat @ np.array([i, j, k], dtype=float)
                if np.linalg.norm(v) <= cutoff:
                    pts.append(v)
    return np.array(pts)

class Kern:
    """Parameterised port of tblite's periodic AES kernels."""
    def __init__(self, c_sd=2.0, c_dd=1.0, c_sq=1.0, k_dd=1.0/6.0, k_sq=-1.0/9.0,
                 g_sd=2.0, g_dd=1.0, g_sq=1.0):
        # energy coefficients
        self.c_sd, self.c_dd, self.c_sq = c_sd, c_dd, c_sq
        self.k_dd, self.k_sq = k_dd, k_sq        # constants as multiples of fac
        # gradient coefficients
        self.g_sd, self.g_dd, self.g_sq = g_sd, g_dd, g_sq

    # ---------------- energy matrices ----------------
    def amat_rec(self, rij, vol, alp, rtrans):
        fac = 4*pi/vol
        sd = np.zeros(3); dd = np.zeros((3, 3)); sq = np.zeros(6)
        dd += np.eye(3)*fac*self.k_dd
        sq[[0, 2, 5]] += fac*self.k_sq
        for g in rtrans:
            g2 = g @ g
            if g2 < EPS: continue
            gv = rij @ g
            expk = fac*exp(-0.25*g2/(alp*alp))/g2
            sink = sin(gv)*expk; cosk = cos(gv)*expk
            sd += self.c_sd*g*sink
            dd += self.c_dd*np.outer(g, g)*cosk
            c = self.c_sq*cosk
            sq[0] += c*g[0]*g[0]; sq[1] += 2*c*g[0]*g[1]; sq[2] += c*g[1]*g[1]
            sq[3] += 2*c*g[0]*g[2]; sq[4] += 2*c*g[1]*g[2]; sq[5] += c*g[2]*g[2]
        return sd, dd, sq

    def amat_dir(self, rij, rr, kdmp3, kdmp5, alp, dtrans):
        sd = np.zeros(3); dd = np.zeros((3, 3)); sq = np.zeros(6)
        alp2 = alp*alp
        for t in dtrans:
            vec = rij + t
            r1 = np.linalg.norm(vec)
            if r1 < 1e-10: continue
            g1 = 1.0/r1; g3 = g1**3; g5 = g3*g1*g1
            fdmp3 = 1.0/(1.0 + 6.0*(rr/r1)**kdmp3)
            fdmp5 = 1.0/(1.0 + 6.0*(rr/r1)**kdmp5)
            arg = r1*alp; expt = exp(-arg*arg)/SQRTPI; erft = -erf(arg)*g1
            e1 = g1*g1*(erft + 2*expt*alp)
            e2 = g1*g1*(e1 + 4*expt*alp2*alp/3)
            sd += vec*(fdmp3*g3 + e1)
            dd += np.eye(3)*(fdmp5*g3 + e1) - np.outer(vec, vec)*3*(g5*fdmp5 + e2)
            b = g5*fdmp5 + e2; a = (fdmp5*g3 + e1)/3.0
            sq[0] += vec[0]*vec[0]*b - a
            sq[1] += 2*vec[0]*vec[1]*b
            sq[2] += vec[1]*vec[1]*b - a
            sq[3] += 2*vec[0]*vec[2]*b
            sq[4] += 2*vec[1]*vec[2]*b
            sq[5] += vec[2]*vec[2]*b - a
        return sd, dd, sq

    def matrices(self, xyz, lattice, rad, kdmp3, kdmp5, alp, dtrans, rtrans):
        nat = len(xyz)
        vol = abs(np.linalg.det(lattice))
        A_sd = np.zeros((3, nat, nat)); A_dd = np.zeros((3, nat, 3, nat)); A_sq = np.zeros((6, nat, nat))
        for iat in range(nat):
            for jat in range(nat):
                vec = xyz[iat] - xyz[jat]
                rr = 0.5*(rad[jat] + rad[iat])
                rsd, rdd, rsq = self.amat_rec(vec, vol, alp, rtrans)
                dsd, ddd, dsq = self.amat_dir(vec, rr, kdmp3, kdmp5, alp, dtrans)
                A_sd[:, jat, iat] += rsd + dsd
                A_dd[:, jat, :, iat] += rdd + ddd
                A_sq[:, jat, iat] += rsq + dsq
        for iat in range(nat):
            rr = -2.0/3.0*alp**3/SQRTPI
            for k in range(3):
                A_dd[k, iat, k, iat] += 2*rr
            rr = 4.0/9.0*alp**3/SQRTPI
            A_sq[[0, 2, 5], iat, iat] += rr
        return A_sd, A_dd, A_sq

    def energy(self, xyz, lattice, rad, kdmp3, kdmp5, alp, q, dp, qp, dtrans, rtrans):
        nat = len(xyz)
        A_sd, A_dd, A_sq = self.matrices(xyz, lattice, rad, kdmp3, kdmp5, alp, dtrans, rtrans)
        e = 0.0
        for i in range(nat):
            for j in range(nat):
                e += q[i]*(dp[j] @ A_sd[:, j, i])
                e += 0.5*(dp[j] @ A_dd[:, j, :, i] @ dp[i])
                e += q[i]*(qp[j] @ A_sq[:, j, i])
        return e

    # ---------------- gradient ----------------
    def damat_rec(self, rij, qi, qj, mi, mj, ti, tj, vol, alp, rtrans):
        fac = 4*pi/vol; alp2 = alp*alp
        dg = np.zeros(3); ds = np.zeros((3, 3))
        for g in rtrans:
            g2 = g @ g
            if g2 < EPS: continue
            gv = rij @ g
            expk = fac*exp(-0.25*g2/alp2)/g2
            cosk = cos(gv)*expk; sink = sin(gv)*expk
            dpiqj = (g @ mi)*qj; qidpj = (g @ mj)*qi
            dg += -self.g_sd*g*cosk*(dpiqj - qidpj)
            pref = (2.0/g2 + 0.5/alp2)
            ds += self.g_sd*sink*(dpiqj - qidpj)*(pref*np.outer(g, g) - np.eye(3)) \
                - 0.5*self.g_sd*sink*(np.outer(g, qj*mi - qi*mj) + np.outer(qj*mi - qi*mj, g))
            dpiv = mi @ g; dpjv = mj @ g
            dg += self.g_dd*g*sink*dpiv*dpjv
            ds += self.g_dd*(cosk*dpiv*dpjv*(pref*np.outer(g, g) - np.eye(3))
                             - 0.5*cosk*(np.outer(g, mi*dpjv + mj*dpiv) + np.outer(mi*dpjv + mj*dpiv, g)))
            T = lambda t: np.array([[t[0], t[1], t[3]], [t[1], t[2], t[4]], [t[3], t[4], t[5]]])
            Ti = T(ti); Tj = T(tj)
            qiqpj = qi*(g @ Tj @ g); qpiqj = qj*(g @ Ti @ g)
            tiv = Ti @ g; tjv = Tj @ g
            dg += self.g_sq*g*sink*(qiqpj + qpiqj)
            ds += self.g_sq*(cosk*(qiqpj + qpiqj)*(pref*np.outer(g, g) - np.eye(3))
                             - cosk*(np.outer(g, qi*tjv + qj*tiv) + np.outer(qi*tjv + qj*tiv, g)))
        return dg, ds

    def damat_dir(self, rij, qi, qj, mi, mj, ti, tj, rr, kdmp3, kdmp5, alp, dtrans):
        alp2 = alp*alp
        de = 0.0; dg = np.zeros(3); ds = np.zeros((3, 3))
        T = lambda t: np.array([[t[0], t[1], t[3]], [t[1], t[2], t[4]], [t[3], t[4], t[5]]])
        Ti = T(ti); Tj = T(tj)
        for t in dtrans:
            vec = rij + t
            r1 = np.linalg.norm(vec)
            if r1 < 1e-10: continue
            r2 = r1*r1; g1 = 1.0/r1; g3 = g1**3; g5 = g3*g1*g1; g7 = g5*g1*g1
            arg = r1*alp; erft = -erf(arg)*g1; expt = exp(-arg*arg)/SQRTPI
            e1 = g1*g1*(erft + expt*(2*alp2)/alp)
            e2 = g1*g1*(e1 + expt*(2*alp2)**2/(3*alp))
            e3 = g1*g1*(e2 + expt*(2*alp2)**3/(15*alp))
            fdmp3 = 1.0/(1.0 + 6.0*(rr*g1)**kdmp3)
            ddmp3 = -3*fdmp3 - kdmp3*fdmp3*(fdmp3 - 1.0)
            fdmp5 = 1.0/(1.0 + 6.0*(rr*g1)**kdmp5)
            ddmp5 = -5*fdmp5 - kdmp5*(fdmp5*fdmp5 - fdmp5)
            dpiqj = (vec @ mi)*qj; qidpj = (vec @ mj)*qi
            dpidpj = mi @ mj; dpiv = mi @ vec; dpjv = mj @ vec
            edd = dpidpj*r2 - 3*dpjv*dpiv
            g_sd = -(ddmp3*g5)*vec*(dpiqj - qidpj) + fdmp3*g3*(qi*mj - qj*mi)
            tab = 3*np.outer(vec, vec)*e2 - np.eye(3)*e1
            g_sd = g_sd + qj*(tab.T @ mi) - qi*(tab.T @ mj)
            de += 3.0*(dpiqj - qidpj)*kdmp3*fdmp3*g3*(fdmp3/rr)*(rr*g1)**kdmp3
            dg += g_sd
            ds += -0.5*(np.outer(vec, g_sd) + np.outer(g_sd, vec))
            g_dd = -2.0*fdmp5*g5*dpidpj*vec + 3.0*fdmp5*g5*(dpiv*mj + dpjv*mi) - edd*ddmp5*g7*vec
            tabc = -15*np.einsum('a,b,c->abc', vec, vec, vec)*e3
            for c in range(3):
                for a in range(3):
                    tabc[a, a, c] += 3*e2*vec[c]
                    tabc[c, a, c] += 3*e2*vec[a]
                    tabc[a, c, c] += 3*e2*vec[a]
            g_dd = g_dd + np.einsum('a,abk,b->k', mi, tabc, mj)
            de += 3.0*edd*kdmp5*fdmp5*g5*(fdmp5/rr)*(rr*g1)**kdmp5
            dg += g_dd
            ds += -0.5*(np.outer(vec, g_dd) + np.outer(g_dd, vec))
            M = qj*Ti + qi*Tj
            eq = vec @ M @ vec
            g_sq = -eq*ddmp5*g7*vec - 2.0*fdmp5*g5*qi*(Tj @ vec) - 2.0*fdmp5*g5*qj*(Ti @ vec)
            g_sq = g_sq + (-qi*np.einsum('abk,ab->k', tabc, Tj) - qj*np.einsum('abk,ab->k', tabc, Ti))/3.0
            de += eq*3.0*kdmp5*fdmp5*g5*fdmp5/rr*(rr*g1)**kdmp5
            dg += g_sq
            ds += -0.5*(np.outer(vec, g_sq) + np.outer(g_sq, vec))
        return de, dg, ds

    def gradient(self, xyz, lattice, rad, kdmp3, kdmp5, alp, q, dp, qp, dtrans, rtrans):
        nat = len(xyz)
        vol = abs(np.linalg.det(lattice))
        grad = np.zeros((nat, 3)); sigma = np.zeros((3, 3)); dEdr = np.zeros(nat)
        for iat in range(nat):
            for jat in range(iat):
                vec = xyz[jat] - xyz[iat]
                rr = 0.5*(rad[jat] + rad[iat])
                dgr, dsr = self.damat_rec(vec, q[iat], q[jat], dp[iat], dp[jat], qp[iat], qp[jat], vol, alp, rtrans)
                ded, dgd, dsd = self.damat_dir(vec, q[iat], q[jat], dp[iat], dp[jat], qp[iat], qp[jat], rr, kdmp3, kdmp5, alp, dtrans)
                grad[iat] += dgd + dgr
                grad[jat] -= dgd + dgr
                sigma += dsd + dsr
                dEdr[iat] += ded; dEdr[jat] += ded
        for iat in range(nat):
            vec = np.zeros(3)
            rr = rad[iat]
            dgr, dsr = self.damat_rec(vec, q[iat], q[iat], dp[iat], dp[iat], qp[iat], qp[iat], vol, alp, rtrans)
            ded, dgd, dsd = self.damat_dir(vec, q[iat], q[iat], dp[iat], dp[iat], qp[iat], qp[iat], rr, kdmp3, kdmp5, alp, dtrans)
            sigma += 0.5*(dsd + dsr)
            dEdr[iat] += ded
        return grad, sigma, dEdr

   !> Molecular structure data
   type(structure_type), intent(in) :: mol
   !> Shift for the generation of the multipolar damping radii

   !> Exponent for the generation of the multipolar damping radii
   real(wp), intent(in) :: kexp
   !> Maximum radius for the multipolar damping radii
   real(wp), intent(in) :: rmax
   !> Base radii for the multipolar damping radii
   real(wp), intent(in) :: rad(:)
   !> Valence coordination number
   real(wp), intent(in) :: valence_cn(:)
   !> Coordination numbers for all atoms
   real(wp), intent(in) :: cn(:)
   !> Multipole damping radii for all atoms
   real(wp), intent(out) :: mrad(:)
   !> Derivative of multipole damping radii with repect to the coordination numbers
   real(wp), intent(out) :: dmrdcn(:)

   integer :: iat, izp
   real(wp) :: arg, t1, t2

   do iat = 1, mol%nat
      izp = mol%id(iat)
      arg = cn(iat) - valence_cn(izp) - shift
      t1 = exp(-kexp*arg)
      t2 = (rmax - rad(izp)) / (1.0_wp + t1)
      mrad(iat) = rad(izp) + t2
      dmrdcn(iat) = -t2 * kexp * t1 / (1.0_wp + t1)
   end do
end subroutine get_mrad

FIX = dict(c_sd=1., c_dd=1., c_sq=-1/3., k_dd=0., k_sq=0.)

def fsmooth(r, rcut, offset=1.0):
    if r < rcut - offset: return 1.0
    if r > rcut: return 0.0
    x = (r - (rcut-offset))/offset
    return -6*x**5 + 15*x**4 - 10*x**3 + 1.0

class KernS(Kern):
    """variant that smoothly switches the damping off beyond rcut"""
    def __init__(self, rcut=10.0, **kw):
        Kern.__init__(self, **kw); self.rcut = rcut
    def amat_dir(self, rij, rr, kdmp3, kdmp5, alp, dtrans):
        sd = np.zeros(3); dd = np.zeros((3,3)); sq = np.zeros(6)
        alp2 = alp*alp
        SQ = sqrt(pi)
        for t in dtrans:
            vec = rij + t
            r1 = np.linalg.norm(vec)
            if r1 < 1e-10: continue
            g1 = 1.0/r1; g3 = g1**3; g5 = g3*g1*g1
            fc = fsmooth(r1, self.rcut)
            fdmp3 = 1.0 - fc*(1.0 - 1.0/(1.0 + 6.0*(rr/r1)**kdmp3))
            fdmp5 = 1.0 - fc*(1.0 - 1.0/(1.0 + 6.0*(rr/r1)**kdmp5))
            arg = r1*alp; expt = exp(-arg*arg)/SQ; erft = -erf(arg)*g1
            e1 = g1*g1*(erft + 2*expt*alp)
            e2 = g1*g1*(e1 + 4*expt*alp2*alp/3)
            sd += vec*(fdmp3*g3 + e1)
            dd += np.eye(3)*(fdmp5*g3 + e1) - np.outer(vec, vec)*3*(g5*fdmp5 + e2)
            b = g5*fdmp5 + e2; a = (fdmp5*g3 + e1)/3.0
            sq[0] += vec[0]*vec[0]*b - a; sq[1] += 2*vec[0]*vec[1]*b
            sq[2] += vec[1]*vec[1]*b - a; sq[3] += 2*vec[0]*vec[2]*b
            sq[4] += 2*vec[1]*vec[2]*b;   sq[5] += vec[2]*vec[2]*b - a
        return sd, dd, sq

pos = np.array([[0,0,0],[1.45,0,0],[2.5,.8,0],[2.5,-.8,0],[-1,.8,0],[-1,-.8,0],[0,0,1.2],[1.45,0,1.2]])/BOHR
nat = len(pos)
np.random.seed(7)
q = np.random.rand(nat)-0.5; q -= q.mean()
dp = 0.15*(np.random.rand(nat,3)-0.5)
qp = 0.3*(np.random.rand(nat,6)-0.5)
for i in range(nat):
    tr = qp[i,0]+qp[i,2]+qp[i,5]; qp[i,[0,2,5]] -= tr/3
rad = np.array([3.0,3.0,1.9,1.9,1.8,1.8,1.8,1.8])   # GFN2 mprad C,N,O

for L_ang in (8.0, 12.0):

    alp = search_alpha(lat)
    def E(k, Rc, Gc, a=alp):
        dt = latpoints(lat, Rc); rt = latpoints(2*pi*np.linalg.inv(lat).T, Gc)
        return k.energy(pos, lat, rad, 3.0, 4.0, a, q, dp, qp, dt, rt)
    k0 = Kern(**FIX); ks = KernS(rcut=10.0, **FIX)
    print("== L=%.1f A  alpha=%.5f" % (L_ang, alp))
    ref = E(k0, 150.0, 10.0)
    print("   plain damping, converged (Rc=150): %.12f" % ref)
    for conv in (100*1.49e-8, 1.49e-8, 1e-12):

    for Rc in (40., 60., 80., 100.):
        print("   plain  Rc=%5.1f Gc=10 : err=%+.3e" % (Rc, E(k0,Rc,10.0)-ref))
    refs = E(ks, 150.0, 10.0)
    print("   smooth(rcut=10), converged: %.12f   (model shift vs plain: %+.3e)" % (refs, refs-ref))
    for conv in (100*1.49e-8, 1.49e-8, 1e-12):

"""5-point FD forces and strain-FD stress for the heteroatom model under PBC (GFN2 with AES)."""
import drv, numpy as np
BOHR = 0.52917721067
sym = ['C','C','N','N','O','O','O','O']
pos0 = np.array([[0,0,0],[1.45,0,0],[2.5,.8,0],[2.5,-.8,0],[-1,.8,0],[-1,-.8,0],[0,0,1.2],[1.45,0,1.2]],dtype=float)
cell0 = np.array([[8.,0.,0.],[0.5,7.5,0.],[0.3,0.4,8.2]])   # non-orthogonal cell
ACC = 1e-7

def energy(pos, cell, param=None, method="gfn2"):
    return drv.run(sym, pos, cell, acc=ACC, param=param, method=method)['energy']

def forces_fd(param=None, method="gfn2", h=0.004):
    g = np.zeros_like(pos0)
    for i in range(len(sym)):
        for k in range(3):
            e = []
            for s in (-2,-1,1,2):
                p = pos0.copy(); p[i,k] += s*h*BOHR
                e.append(energy(p, cell0, param, method))
            g[i,k] = (e[0]-8*e[1]+8*e[2]-e[3])/(12*h)
    return g

def stress_fd(param=None, method="gfn2", h=2e-4):
    V = abs(np.linalg.det(cell0/BOHR))
    s = np.zeros((3,3))
    for a in range(3):
        for b in range(3):
            e = []
            for m in (-2,-1,1,2):
                eps = np.eye(3); eps[a,b] += m*h
                c = cell0 @ eps.T; p = pos0 @ eps.T
                e.append(energy(p, c, param, method))
            s[a,b] = (e[0]-8*e[1]+8*e[2]-e[3])/(12*h)
    return 0.5*(s+s.T)/V

for label, kw in (("GFN2 (AES on)", dict(param="/tmp/gfn2.toml")),
                  ("GFN2 (AES off)", dict(param="/tmp/gfn2_nomp.toml"))):
    d = drv.run(sym, pos0, cell0, acc=ACC, **kw)
    ga = np.array(d['gradient']).reshape(-1,3)
    V = abs(np.linalg.det(cell0/BOHR))
    sa = np.array(d['virial']).reshape(3,3)/V
    gn = forces_fd(**kw); sn = stress_fd(**kw)
    print("%-15s max|dE/dR ana-num| = %.2e Eh/a0   max|sigma ana-num| = %.2e Eh/a0^3"
          % (label, np.abs(ga-gn).max(), np.abs(sa-sn).max()))
    print("                max|dE/dR| = %.4f      max|sigma| = %.6f" % (np.abs(ga).max(), np.abs(sa).max()))
EOF

   real(wp), intent(in) :: kdmp3

   !> Derivative of the energy w.r.t. the critical radii

   !> Derivative of the energy w.r.t. atomic displacements
   real(wp), contiguous, intent(inout) :: gradient(:, :)
   !> Derivative of the energy w.r.t. strain deformations
   real(wp), contiguous, intent(inout) :: sigma(:, :)

   integer :: iat, jat, img
   real(wp) :: vec(3), dG(3), dGr(3), dGd(3), dS(3, 3), dSr(3, 3), dSd(3, 3)
   real(wp) :: wsw, vol, rr, dE, dEd

   call get_rec_trans(mol%lattice, alpha, vol, conv, rtrans)

   !$omp shared(mol, wsc, kdmp3, kdmp5, vol, alpha, rtrans, dtrans, rad, qat, dpat, qpat) &
   !$omp private(iat, jat, dE, dG, dS, wsw, img, vec, rr, dEd, dGd, dGr, dSd, dSr)
   do iat = 1, mol%nat
      do jat = 1, iat - 1
         dE = 0.0_wp
         dG(:) = 0.0_wp
         dS(:, :) = 0.0_wp
         wsw = 1.0_wp / real(wsc%nimg(jat, iat), wp)
         do img = 1, wsc%nimg(jat, iat)
            vec(:) = mol%xyz(:, jat)-mol%xyz(:, iat) + wsc%trans(:, wsc%tridx(img, jat, iat))

   !$omp private(iat, jat, r1, r2, vec, rr, fdmp3, fdmp5, g1, g3, g5, g7, dG, dS, &
   !$omp& ddmp3, ddmp5, fddr, eq, edd, dpidpj, dpiv, dpjv, dpiqj, qidpj)

         vec(:) = mol%xyz(:, jat)-mol%xyz(:, iat)

         r2 = r1 * r1
         g1 = 1.0_wp/r1
         g3 = g1 * g1 * g1
         g5 = g3 * g1 * g1
         g7 = g5 * g1 * g1

         ddmp3 = -3*g5*fdmp3 - kdmp3*fdmp3*(fdmp3-1.0_wp)*g5
         fdmp5 = 1.0_wp/(1.0_wp+6.0_wp*(rr*g1)**kdmp5)
         ddmp5 = -5*fdmp5 - kdmp5*(fdmp5*fdmp5-fdmp5)

         dpiqj = dot_product(vec, dpat(:, iat))*qat(jat)
         qidpj = dot_product(vec, dpat(:, jat))*qat(iat)
         fddr = 3.0_wp*(dpiqj - qidpj)*kdmp3*fdmp3*g3*(fdmp3/rr)*(rr*g1)**kdmp3
         dg(:) = - ddmp3*vec * (dpiqj - qidpj) &
            & + fdmp3*g3*(qat(iat)*dpat(:, jat) - qat(jat)*dpat(:, iat))
         ds(:, :) = - 0.5_wp * (spread(vec, 1, 3) * spread(dG, 2, 3) &
            & + spread(dG, 1, 3) * spread(vec, 2, 3))

         dEdr(iat) = dEdr(iat) + fddr
         dEdr(jat) = dEdr(jat) + fddr

         gradient(:, jat) = gradient(:, jat) - dG

         dpiv = dot_product(dpat(:, iat), vec)
         dpjv = dot_product(dpat(:, jat), vec)

            & + 3.0_wp*fdmp5*g5*(dpiv*dpat(:, jat) + dpjv*dpat(:, iat)) &
            & - edd*ddmp5*g7*vec

            & + spread(dg, 1, 3) * spread(vec, 2, 3))

         dEdr(jat) = dEdr(jat) + fddr

            & + 2*(qat(jat)*qpat(4,iat) + qpat(4,jat)*qat(iat))*vec(1)*vec(3) &
            & + 2*(qat(jat)*qpat(5,iat) + qpat(5,jat)*qat(iat))*vec(2)*vec(3) &
            & + (qat(jat)*qpat(1,iat) + qpat(1,jat)*qat(iat))*vec(1)*vec(1) &
            & + (qat(jat)*qpat(3,iat) + qpat(3,jat)*qat(iat))*vec(2)*vec(2) &
            & + (qat(jat)*qpat(6,iat) + qpat(6,jat)*qat(iat))*vec(3)*vec(3)

            & - 2.0_wp*fdmp5*g5*qat(iat) * &

            & vec(1)*qpat(4,jat) + vec(2)*qpat(5,jat) + vec(3)*qpat(6,jat)] &
            & - 2.0_wp*fdmp5*g5*qat(jat) * &
            &[vec(1)*qpat(1,iat) + vec(2)*qpat(2,iat) + vec(3)*qpat(4,iat), &
            & vec(1)*qpat(2,iat) + vec(2)*qpat(3,iat) + vec(3)*qpat(5,iat), &
            & vec(1)*qpat(4,iat) + vec(2)*qpat(5,iat) + vec(3)*qpat(6,iat)]

            & + spread(dG, 1, 3) * spread(vec, 2, 3))

         dEdr(iat) = dEdr(iat) + fddr
         dEdr(jat) = dEdr(jat) + fddr

         gradient(:, jat) = gradient(:, jat) - dg
         sigma(:, :) = sigma + ds

   type(coulomb_cache), pointer :: ptr

   call taint(cache, ptr)
   call ptr%update(mol)

   if (.not.allocated(ptr%mrad)) then
      allocate(ptr%mrad(mol%nat))
   end if
   if (.not.allocated(ptr%dmrdcn)) then
      allocate(ptr%dmrdcn(mol%nat))

      allocate(ptr%amat_sd(3, mol%nat, mol%nat))

   if (.not.allocated(ptr%amat_dd)) then
      allocate(ptr%amat_dd(3, mol%nat, 3, mol%nat))
   end if
   if (.not.allocated(ptr%amat_sq)) then
      allocate(ptr%amat_sq(6, mol%nat, mol%nat))
   end if

   if (.not.allocated(ptr%cn)) then
      allocate(ptr%cn(mol%nat))
   end if
   if (.not.allocated(ptr%dcndr)) then
      allocate(ptr%dcndr(3, mol%nat, mol%nat))

subroutine get_energy(self, mol, cache, wfn, energies)
   !> Instance of the multipole container
   class(damped_multipole), intent(in) :: self
   !> Molecular structure data
   type(structure_type), intent(in) :: mol
   !> Wavefunction data
   type(wavefunction_type), intent(in) :: wfn
   !> Electrostatic energy
   real(wp), intent(inout) :: energies(:)
   !> Reusable data container
   type(container_cache), intent(inout) :: cache

   real(wp), allocatable :: vs(:), vd(:, :), vq(:, :)
   type(coulomb_cache), pointer :: ptr

   call view(cache, ptr)

   allocate(vs(mol%nat), vd(3, mol%nat), vq(6, mol%nat))

   call gemv(ptr%amat_sd, wfn%qat(:, 1), vd)
   call gemv(ptr%amat_dd, wfn%dpat(:, :, 1), vd, beta=1.0_wp, alpha=0.5_wp)
   call gemv(ptr%amat_sq, wfn%qat(:, 1), vq)

   energies(:) = energies + sum(wfn%dpat(:, :, 1) * vd, 1) + sum(wfn%qpat(:, :, 1) * vq, 1)

   call get_kernel_energy(mol, self%dkernel, wfn%dpat(:, :, 1), energies)
   call get_kernel_energy(mol, self%qkernel, wfn%qpat(:, :, 1), energies)
end subroutine get_energy

!> Get anisotropic electrostatic energy
subroutine get_energy_aes(self, mol, cache, wfn, energies)
   !> Instance of the multipole container
   class(damped_multipole), intent(in) :: self
   !> Molecular structure data
   type(structure_type), intent(in) :: mol
   !> Wavefunction data
   type(wavefunction_type), intent(in) :: wfn
   !> Electrostatic energy
   real(wp), intent(inout) :: energies(:)
   !> Reusable data container
   type(container_cache), intent(inout) :: cache

   real(wp), allocatable :: vs(:), vd(:, :), vq(:, :),mur(:)
   real(wp), allocatable :: e01(:),e11(:),e02(:)
   real(wp), allocatable :: t1(:)
   type(coulomb_cache), pointer :: ptr
   integer :: i,j

   call view(cache, ptr)

   allocate(vs(mol%nat), vd(3, mol%nat), vq(6, mol%nat))

   allocate(mur(mol%nat), source=0.0_wp)
   allocate(e01(mol%nat),e11(mol%nat),e02(mol%nat),source=0.0_wp)
   allocate(t1(mol%nat),source=0.0_wp)

   call gemv(ptr%amat_sd, wfn%qat(:, 1), vd)
   do i = 1,3
      call gemv(ptr%amat_sd(i,:,:),wfn%dpat(i,:,1),mur,beta=1.0_wp, alpha=1.0_wp,trans="T")
   end do

   e01 = (mur)*wfn%qat(:,1) + sum(wfn%dpat(:, :, 1) * vd, 1)

   vd = 0.0_wp
   call gemv(ptr%amat_dd, wfn%dpat(:, :, 1), vd, beta=1.0_wp, alpha=0.5_wp)
   e11 = sum(wfn%dpat(:, :, 1) * vd, 1)

   call gemv(ptr%amat_sq, wfn%qat(:, 1), vq)

   do i = 1,6
      call gemv(ptr%amat_sq(i,:,:),wfn%qpat(i,:,1),t1,beta=1.0_wp, alpha=1.0_wp,trans="T")
   end do
   e02 = t1*wfn%qat(:,1) + sum(wfn%qpat(:, :, 1) * vq, 1)

   energies(:) = energies + 0.5_wp * e01 + e11 + 0.5_wp * e02

end subroutine get_energy_aes

!> Get multipolar anisotropic exchange-correlation kernel
subroutine get_kernel_energy(mol, kernel, mpat, energies)
   !> Molecular structure data
   type(structure_type), intent(in) :: mol
   !> Multipole kernel
   real(wp), intent(in) :: kernel(:)
   !> Atomic multipole momemnt
   real(wp), intent(in) :: mpat(:, :)
   !> Electrostatic energy
   real(wp), intent(inout) :: energies(:)

   integer :: iat, izp
   real(wp) :: mpt(size(mpat, 1)), mpscale(size(mpat, 1))

   mpscale(:) = 1
   if (size(mpat, 1) == 6) mpscale([2, 4, 5]) = 2

   do iat = 1, mol%nat
      izp = mol%id(iat)
      mpt(:) = mpat(:, iat) * mpscale
      energies(iat) = energies(iat) + kernel(izp) * dot_product(mpt, mpat(:, iat))
   end do
end subroutine get_kernel_energy

import ctypes
import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import numpy as np


TASK_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent

def write_report(payload: dict[str, Any], exit_code: int) -> int:

    REPORT_PATH.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    print(text, end="")
    return exit_code


def _native_file() -> Path:
    native = BUILD_ROOT / "native.ini"
    native.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    python_exe = Path(sys.executable).as_posix()

        "[binaries]\n"
        "c = 'gcc'\n"
        "cpp = 'g++'\n"
        "fortran = 'gfortran'\n"
        "ar = 'ar'\n"
        "ld = 'ld'\n"
    )

        native.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")
    return native

        "--native-file",

!> Generate lattice points from repeatitions
subroutine get_lattice_points_rep_3d(lat, rep, origin, trans)

   !> Lattice vectors
   real(wp), intent(in) :: lat(:, :)

   !> Repeatitions of lattice points to generate
   integer, intent(in) :: rep(:)

   !> Include the origin in the generated lattice points
   logical, intent(in) :: origin

   !> Generated lattice points
   real(wp), allocatable, intent(out) :: trans(:, :)

   integer :: itr, ix, iy, iz, jx, jy, jz

   itr = 0
   if (origin) then
      allocate(trans(3, product(2*rep+1)))
      do ix = 0, rep(1)
         do iy = 0, rep(2)
            do iz = 0, rep(3)
               do jx = 1, merge(-1, 1, ix > 0), -2
                  do jy = 1, merge(-1, 1, iy > 0), -2
                     do jz = 1, merge(-1, 1, iz > 0), -2
                        itr = itr + 1
                        trans(:, itr) = lat(:, 1)*ix*jx &
                           & + lat(:, 2)*iy*jy + lat(:, 3)*iz*jz
                     end do
                  end do
               end do
            end do
         end do
      end do
   else
      allocate(trans(3, product(2*rep+1)-1))
      do ix = 0, rep(1)
         do iy = 0, rep(2)
            do iz = 0, rep(3)
               if (ix == 0 .and. iy == 0 .and. iz == 0) cycle
               do jx = 1, merge(-1, 1, ix > 0), -2
                  do jy = 1, merge(-1, 1, iy > 0), -2
                     do jz = 1, merge(-1, 1, iz > 0), -2
                        itr = itr + 1
                        trans(:, itr) = lat(:, 1)*ix*jx &
                           & + lat(:, 2)*iy*jy + lat(:, 3)*iz*jz
                     end do
                  end do
               end do
            end do
         end do
      end do
   end if

end subroutine get_lattice_points_rep_3d

responses for the supplied molecular model.  However, two valid periodic-cell
representations of the same model do not give mutually consistent energy
observations.  The discrepancy changes with the molecular composition and the
cell geometry.

The source snapshot, the public workflow, and the cited method material are the
complete offline workbench.  Find and repair the scientific inconsistency in
the source while retaining the documented API and physical units.  Validate
the behavior on more than the displayed example; a fixture-specific numerical
adjustment is not a solution.

"""5-point FD forces and strain-FD stress for the heteroatom model under PBC (GFN2 with AES)."""
import drv, numpy as np
BOHR = 0.52917721067
sym = ['C','C','N','N','O','O','O','O']
pos0 = np.array([[0,0,0],[1.45,0,0],[2.5,.8,0],[2.5,-.8,0],[-1,.8,0],[-1,-.8,0],[0,0,1.2],[1.45,0,1.2]],dtype=float)
cell0 = np.array([[8.,0.,0.],[0.5,7.5,0.],[0.3,0.4,8.2]])   # non-orthogonal cell
ACC = 1e-7

def energy(pos, cell, param=None, method="gfn2"):
    return drv.run(sym, pos, cell, acc=ACC, param=param, method=method)['energy']

def forces_fd(param=None, method="gfn2", h=0.004):
    g = np.zeros_like(pos0)
    for i in range(len(sym)):
        for k in range(3):
            e = []
            for s in (-2,-1,1,2):
                p = pos0.copy(); p[i,k] += s*h*BOHR
                e.append(energy(p, cell0, param, method))
            g[i,k] = (e[0]-8*e[1]+8*e[2]-e[3])/(12*h)
    return g

def stress_fd(param=None, method="gfn2", h=2e-4):
    V = abs(np.linalg.det(cell0/BOHR))
    s = np.zeros((3,3))
    for a in range(3):
        for b in range(3):
            e = []
            for m in (-2,-1,1,2):
                eps = np.eye(3); eps[a,b] += m*h
                c = cell0 @ eps.T; p = pos0 @ eps.T
                e.append(energy(p, c, param, method))
            s[a,b] = (e[0]-8*e[1]+8*e[2]-e[3])/(12*h)
    return 0.5*(s+s.T)/V

for label, kw in (("GFN2 (AES on)", dict(param="/tmp/gfn2.toml")),
                  ("GFN2 (AES off)", dict(param="/tmp/gfn2_nomp.toml"))):
    d = drv.run(sym, pos0, cell0, acc=ACC, **kw)
    ga = np.array(d['gradient']).reshape(-1,3)
    V = abs(np.linalg.det(cell0/BOHR))
    sa = np.array(d['virial']).reshape(3,3)/V
    gn = forces_fd(**kw); sn = stress_fd(**kw)
    print("%-15s max|dE/dR ana-num| = %.2e Eh/a0   max|sigma ana-num| = %.2e Eh/a0^3"
          % (label, np.abs(ga-gn).max(), np.abs(sa-sn).max()))
    print("                max|dE/dR| = %.4f      max|sigma| = %.6f" % (np.abs(ga).max(), np.abs(sa).max()))

!$omp parallel do default(none) schedule(runtime) collapse(2) &
   !$omp shared(amat_sd, amat_dd, amat_sq, mol, rad, kdmp3, kdmp5) &
   !$omp private(r1, vec, g1, g3, g5, fdmp3, fdmp5, tc, rr)
   do iat = 1, mol%nat
      do jat = 1, mol%nat
         if (iat == jat) cycle
         vec(:) = mol%xyz(:, iat) - mol%xyz(:, jat)
         r1 = norm2(vec)
         g1 = 1.0_wp / r1
         g3 = g1 * g1 * g1
         g5 = g3 * g1 * g1

         rr = 0.5_wp * (rad(jat) + rad(iat)) * g1
         fdmp3 = 1.0_wp / (1.0_wp + 6.0_wp * rr**kdmp3)
         fdmp5 = 1.0_wp / (1.0_wp + 6.0_wp * rr**kdmp5)

         amat_sd(:, jat, iat) = amat_sd(:, jat, iat) + vec * g3 * fdmp3
         amat_dd(:, jat, :, iat) = amat_dd(:, jat, :, iat) &
            & + unity * g3*fdmp5 - spread(vec, 1, 3) * spread(vec, 2, 3) * 3*g5*fdmp5
         tc(2) = 2*vec(1)*vec(2)*g5*fdmp5
         tc(4) = 2*vec(1)*vec(3)*g5*fdmp5
         tc(5) = 2*vec(2)*vec(3)*g5*fdmp5
         tc(1) = vec(1)*vec(1)*g5*fdmp5
         tc(3) = vec(2)*vec(2)*g5*fdmp5
         tc(6) = vec(3)*vec(3)*g5*fdmp5
         amat_sq(:, jat, iat) = amat_sq(:, jat, iat) + tc
      end do
   end do

!> Evaluate multipole interaction matrix under 3D periodic boundary conditions
subroutine get_multipole_matrix_3d(mol, rad, kdmp3, kdmp5, wsc, alpha, &
      & amat_sd, amat_dd, amat_sq)
   !> Molecular structure data
   type(structure_type), intent(in) :: mol
   !> Multipole damping radii for all atoms
   real(wp), intent(in) :: rad(:)
   !> Damping function for inverse quadratic contributions
   real(wp), intent(in) :: kdmp3
   !> Damping function for inverse cubic contributions
   real(wp), intent(in) :: kdmp5
   !> Wigner-Seitz cell images
   type(wignerseitz_cell), intent(in) :: wsc
   !> Convergence parameter for Ewald sum
   real(wp), intent(in) :: alpha
   !> Interation matrix for charges and dipoles
   real(wp), intent(inout) :: amat_sd(:, :, :)
   !> Interation matrix for dipoles and dipoles
   real(wp), intent(inout) :: amat_dd(:, :, :, :)
   !> Interation matrix for charges and quadrupoles
   real(wp), intent(inout) :: amat_sq(:, :, :)

   integer :: iat, jat, img, k
   real(wp) :: vec(3), rr, wsw, vol
   real(wp) :: d_sd(3), d_dd(3, 3), d_sq(6), r_sd(3), r_dd(3, 3), r_sq(6)
   real(wp), allocatable :: dtrans(:, :), rtrans(:, :)

   vol = abs(matdet_3x3(mol%lattice))
   call get_dir_trans(mol%lattice, alpha, conv, dtrans)
   call get_rec_trans(mol%lattice, alpha, vol, conv, rtrans)

   !$omp parallel do default(none) schedule(runtime) collapse(2) &
   !$omp shared(amat_sd, amat_dd, amat_sq) &
   !$omp shared(mol, wsc, rad, vol, alpha, rtrans, dtrans, kdmp3, kdmp5) &
   !$omp private(iat, jat, img, vec, rr, wsw, d_sd, d_dd, d_sq, r_sd, r_dd, r_sq)
   do iat = 1, mol%nat
      do jat = 1, mol%nat
         wsw = 1.0_wp / real(wsc%nimg(jat, iat), wp)
         do img = 1, wsc%nimg(jat, iat)
            vec = mol%xyz(:, iat) - mol%xyz(:, jat) - wsc%trans(:, wsc%tridx(img, jat, iat))

            rr = 0.5_wp * (rad(jat) + rad(iat))
            call get_amat_sdq_rec_3d(vec, vol, alpha, rtrans, r_sd, r_dd, r_sq)
            call get_amat_sdq_dir_3d(vec, rr, kdmp3, kdmp5, alpha, dtrans, d_sd, d_dd, d_sq)

            amat_sd(:, jat, iat) = amat_sd(:, jat, iat) + wsw * (d_sd + r_sd)
            amat_dd(:, jat, :, iat) = amat_dd(:, jat, :, iat) + wsw * (r_dd + d_dd)
            amat_sq(:, jat, iat) = amat_sq(:, jat, iat) + wsw * (r_sq + d_sq)
         end do
      end do
   end do

   !$omp parallel do default(none) schedule(runtime) &
   !$omp shared(amat_sd, amat_dd, amat_sq, mol, vol, alpha) private(iat, rr, k)
   do iat = 1, mol%nat
      ! dipole-dipole selfenergy: -2/3·α³/sqrt(π) Σ(i) μ²(i)
      rr = -2.0_wp/3.0_wp * alpha**3 / sqrtpi
      do k = 1, 3
         amat_dd(k, iat, k, iat) = amat_dd(k, iat, k, iat) + 2*rr
      end do

      ! charge-quadrupole selfenergy: 4/9·α³/sqrt(π) Σ(i) q(i)Tr(θi)
      ! (no actual contribution since quadrupoles are traceless)
      rr = 4.0_wp/9.0_wp * alpha**3 / sqrtpi
      amat_sq([1, 3, 6], iat, iat) = amat_sq([1, 3, 6], iat, iat) + rr
   end do
end subroutine get_multipole_matrix_3d

subroutine get_mrad(mol, shift, kexp, rmax, rad, valence_cn, cn, mrad, dmrdcn)
   !> Molecular structure data
   type(structure_type), intent(in) :: mol
   !> Shift for the generation of the multipolar damping radii
   real(wp), intent(in) :: shift
   !> Exponent for the generation of the multipolar damping radii
   real(wp), intent(in) :: kexp
   !> Maximum radius for the multipolar damping radii
   real(wp), intent(in) :: rmax
   !> Base radii for the multipolar damping radii
   real(wp), intent(in) :: rad(:)
   !> Valence coordination number
   real(wp), intent(in) :: valence_cn(:)
   !> Coordination numbers for all atoms
   real(wp), intent(in) :: cn(:)
   !> Multipole damping radii for all atoms
   real(wp), intent(out) :: mrad(:)
   !> Derivative of multipole damping radii with repect to the coordination numbers
   real(wp), intent(out) :: dmrdcn(:)

   integer :: iat, izp
   real(wp) :: arg, t1, t2

   do iat = 1, mol%nat
      izp = mol%id(iat)
      arg = cn(iat) - valence_cn(izp) - shift
      t1 = exp(-kexp*arg)
      t2 = (rmax - rad(izp)) / (1.0_wp + t1)
      mrad(iat) = rad(izp) + t2
      dmrdcn(iat) = -t2 * kexp * t1 / (1.0_wp + t1)
   end do
end subroutine get_mrad

   !> Instance of the multipole container
   class(damped_multipole), intent(in) :: self
   !> Molecular structure data
   type(structure_type), intent(in) :: mol

   type(container_cache), intent(inout) :: cache

   type(coulomb_cache), pointer :: ptr

   call taint(cache, ptr)
   call ptr%update(mol)

   if (.not.allocated(ptr%mrad)) then
      allocate(ptr%mrad(mol%nat))
   end if
   if (.not.allocated(ptr%dmrdcn)) then
      allocate(ptr%dmrdcn(mol%nat))
   end if

   if (.not.allocated(ptr%amat_sd)) then
      allocate(ptr%amat_sd(3, mol%nat, mol%nat))
   end if
   if (.not.allocated(ptr%amat_dd)) then
      allocate(ptr%amat_dd(3, mol%nat, 3, mol%nat))
   end if
   if (.not.allocated(ptr%amat_sq)) then
      allocate(ptr%amat_sq(6, mol%nat, mol%nat))

   if (.not.allocated(ptr%cn)) then
      allocate(ptr%cn(mol%nat))

   if (.not.allocated(ptr%dcndr)) then

## Repair complete

**Root cause** — `source/src/tblite/coulomb/multipole.f90`, reciprocal-space part of the GFN2 anisotropic-electrostatics (AES) kernels (`get_amat_sdq_rec_3d`, plus its derivative twin `get_damat_sdq_rec_3d`).

The direct-space kernels and the Ewald self-energies in that file implement the multipole kernels as exact derivatives of the *same* screened lattice potential used for the isotropic Coulomb term (tinfoil boundary conditions):

```
A_sd = -∇φ,   A_dd = -∇∇φ,   A_sq = ∇∇φ/3 = -A_dd/3
```

The reciprocal part violated all three relations: charge–dipole was scaled by 2, charge–quadrupole had the wrong sign *and* no 1/3, and two spurious `G = 0` constants (`fac/6` on the dd diagonal, `−fac/9` on the sq trace) had been added although the omitted `G = 0` term of φ is *r*-independent and cannot contribute to its derivatives. Consequently the Ewald splitting parameter α no longer cancelled between direct and reciprocal sums — and α is picked from the cell metric (`search_alpha`), so every valid representation of the same system (super cell, sheared/unimodular cell, cell size) produced a different energy. Because the gradient routine carried the *same* wrong scalings, forces/stress stayed consistent with the wrong energy, which is why the workflow looked healthy.

**Fix** — restore the exact derivative relations in the energy kernels and apply exactly the same scalings to the gradient/virial kernels (31 insertions / 18 deletions, one file). No interface, parameter, unit or build change; the 0-D (molecular) path is untouched.

**Validation** (all through the public interfaces; GFN1-xTB, which has no AES, as control)

| check (eV per unit cell) | baseline | repaired | GFN1 control |
|---|---|---|---|
| C2N2O4 8 Å, E(2×2×2)/8 − E(cell) | −6.35e−2 | **+6.10e−4** | +1.56e−4 |
| 4 H2O in 7 Å box, 2×1×1 | −1.16e−1 | **−3.21e−4** | −3.29e−4 |
| 6 H2O in 8 Å box, 2×1×1 | −3.52e−2 | **−9.68e−4** | −6.01e−4 |
| urea-like in 8 Å, 2×1×1 | −1.59e−2 | **−1.88e−3** | −1.48e−3 |
| E(cubic 10 Å) − E(isolated molecule) | +7.69e−2 | **+3.86e−3** | — |
| E(cubic 20 Å) − E(isolated molecule) | +3.53e−3 | **−6.07e−5** | — |
| rigid shift / wrapping invariance | 1e−13 | 1e−13 | 1e−13 |

- The GFN2 super-cell residual now *equals the AES-free control*, i.e. what remains is Γ-point band folding, not electrostatics (HCN chain: 1.15 eV in GFN2 **and** 1.22 eV in GFN1).
- Unimodular cell-choice invariance (no folding, sharpest test): GFN1 exact to ~1e−11 Eh; GFN2 residual 1e−6…3e−5 Eh is *identical* before and after the repair (−2.69e−5 vs −2.70e−5 Eh) and shrinks to ~3e−7 Eh when the real-space cutoff is enlarged (Rc ≥ 80 a0) — it is the upstream truncation of the algebraically decaying damped multipole tail, not the injected defect, so I deliberately left the shipped accuracy/cost trade-off (`conv = 100·√ε`) and the `wignerseitz` image bookkeeping alone (the latter is byte-identical to the independent upstream copy vendored in `subprojects/multicharge`).
- Gradients: 5-point FD forces and symmetric strain-FD stress on a skew cell give 7.8e−6 Eh/a0 and 9.7e−6 Eh/a0³, matching the baseline (7.9e−6 / 9.6e−6, a pre-existing CN-chain-rule effect in the damping radii). Control run with the energy repaired but the reciprocal gradient left untouched: 9.7e−4 Eh/a0 (123× worse) — the two halves of the fix are exact derivatives of each other.
- Non-periodic results are bit-identical (C2N2O4 0-D −697.9402316515 eV; H2O GFN2 −137.9677759436 eV, GFN1 −156.9675059028 eV — documented reference values), and all GFN1 periodic energies are unchanged to every digit.
- A clean, fully offline meson/ninja build from scratch succeeds; native Python API and CLI both work under PBC.
